caption: The drawing depicts a single animal figure, rendered twice from different angles, positioned on a plain, beige background. The object resembles a pig or boar and appears to be a small sculpture or figurine made of a material that has a brownish, metallic appearance with hints of greenish and reddish tones, suggesting patina or weathering. On the left side, the figure is shown from the front left, displaying its face, ears, snout, and two legs tucked underneath its body. There is a decorative element on the animal’s back, resembling a ribbon or ornamental tie. On the right side, the same object is shown from an elevated rear view, focusing on the back, rump, and the curve of the spine, with the tail and legs also visible. The surface of the object shows shadow and highlights, conveying depth and three-dimensionality. The background is devoid of any additional objects or details. In the bottom right corner, there is a small, faintly visible signature.
title: Prize Pig Coin Bank
